entry.name: pollIntervalSeconds
entry.label: How often the widget asks systemd for the daemon state, in seconds.

entry.name: iconName
entry.label: Icon shown in the panel. Any icon name available in the active theme.

entry.name: showContainerList
entry.label: List the containers in the popup while the daemon is running.

entry.name: showVideoDownloader
entry.label: Show the video download row in the popup.

entry.name: downloadDirectory
entry.label: Folder the downloaded videos are written to. "~/" is expanded to your home directory.

entry.name: jsRuntime
entry.label: JavaScript runtime yt-dlp needs for YouTube challenges, e.g. "node" or "deno". Leave empty to not pass --js-runtimes at all (a yt-dlp too old for that flag).

entry.name: ytDlpBinary
entry.label: yt-dlp executable name or path, e.g. "yt-dlp" or "~/.local/bin/yt-dlp".

entry.name: cookiesBrowser
entry.label: Browser the video download reads its cookies from, e.g. "firefox" or "chrome:Default". Supports yt-dlp syntax (BROWSER+KEYRING:PROFILE). Leave empty to download without cookies.

entry.name: taglineText
entry.label: Muted text shown at the bottom of the widget. Leave empty to hide it.
